name: nGZGraphic4::GetDeviceTargetSize(out) (cdecl: the current device's render-target size, aspect and format; the back buffer's when the device is ready)
notes: Lane VU (O-c). Cdecl, one argument, returns it. Callers: cRenderTargetTexture::Restore 0xab5240 and cViewerRefNodeBaseImpl::GetTargetSize 0xae1000 (both ours) and game code; hooked at the RVA. The current device (0x18ae40), its enumeration's adapter display mode (cIDeviceEnum slot 6) copied as width, height, aspect and format (the refresh dropped); when the device is ready (slot 35), back buffer 0's (slot 39) width, height and pixel format replace them, the aspect kept. Difftest DeviceTargetSize (tests/gz_device_target_size.cpp, 3000 seeded cases: the device getter stood in on both sides; fakes of the device, its enumeration and the back buffer whose other slots note themselves; seeded mode words with signalling-NaN aspects, a ready word with seeded high bytes; compared: the call log with arguments, the result and the out buffer with a word of slack each side). Mutants (6, build/vu_mut2a.json): the ready branch dropped, width and height swapped, the back format not taken, swap chain 1, the aspect not copied, the mode format not copied: 6 killed.
